name: thought-mesh
description: Interconnected note taking: a Go server over a folder of plain markdown files, serving an installable PWA with wikilinks, backlinks and a graph.
author: Chinmay Manjunath

scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: cd server && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w -X github.com/chinmay28/thought-mesh/server/internal/version.Patch=$(node ../scripts/version.mjs --patch)" -o bin/thoughtmesh ./cmd/thoughtmesh
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run vet:server
